ProcureSphere 360 Onboarding Policy

To maintain audit compliance, only documents in PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLSX, and CSV formats are permitted. Image files (PNG, JPG, JPEG) are prohibited to prevent unverified alterations. Standard review turnaround time is 24 to 48 business hours. If you require assistance, submit an inquiry via the Vendor Helpdesk.
